divergences.toil: Run each source separately: toil deps frisk --source osv, --source sonatype, --source sonatypeiq
divergences.why: No command fans out to several services on the caller's behalf. Single-source deps frisk stays, as a thin alias over the per-source commands (toil osv vulns, toil ossindex vulns, toil sonatypeiq evaluate).

divergences.toil: Removed. Check each source with its own config test
divergences.why: It decides on the caller's behalf which services to contact.

divergences.old: deps scan and deps diff always working from the repository root, even from a subdirectory
divergences.toil: deps scan and deps diff read only inside the workspace folder: when the repository root is above the workspace, scan lists the workspace subtree, and diff lists and reads each ref's files under the same folder (git ls-tree and git show <ref>:./<path> run in the workspace). Run them from the repository root, or pass --workspace <root>, to cover the whole repository
divergences.why: Files a command reads stay inside the workspace; only .git metadata may be read above it (decision 2 on #68, docs/bounds.md).

divergences.old: deps scan finding files the way git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard does, global excludes included
divergences.toil: The listing (ctx.files.list) applies .gitignore files and .git/info/exclude but not core.excludesFile or the default ~/.config/git/ignore, so a file only those ignore is listed
divergences.why: Reading above the workspace is limited to .git, the global git config and its includes, and parent .gitignore files (docs/bounds.md, git.read-up; #68 decision 7).

divergences.old: deps scan skipping manifests at paths git ls-files quotes (non-ASCII names, with core.quotePath on)
divergences.toil: deps scan reads them: its file list comes from walking the workspace, not from git's quoted output. deps diff still skips them at a ref, since git ls-tree quotes them there too (#91 item 25)
divergences.why: deps scan walks the folder rather than running git ls-files (maintainer decision on #42), and the walk has real names, not quoted ones.

divergences.old: deps diff with an empty --from, or a --from or --to starting with -, running git and reporting an empty inventory for that side
divergences.toil: Refused with INVALID_INPUT before git runs. Any other ref git can't read still gives an empty inventory (#91 item 20)
divergences.why: A value starting with - would reach git as an option; core refuses it for every command that runs git (CLAUDE.md, No Executables).
